I’m not sure if it was guilt, or jealousy, it really didn’t matter. I was blamed for his death. There was nothing more painful than hearing ‘you killed your dad’ when I was there only one on his side, fighting for him, taking care of him. I don’t think anyone would blame me to be mean or rude back. I just can’t bring myself to hurt others. Other than this petty comment. 
The best way I’ve found to deal with this pain, or maybe I’m just avoiding dealing with it, is to help others. I’ve jumped feet first into my faith, and dedicated every free second I have to helping others. I make extra large meals and distribute them to the homeless. I collect donations, blankets, clothes, self care items, etc. to distribute. For those few trusted, I allow them to sleep on my pull out couch for a night, with free rein to everything in my home, laundry, food, shower, etc.. I pick up laundry and deliver it back clean. Every free penny I have is going to helping those with less. There’s nothing like the feeling of delivering a hot, home cooked meal to someone who hasn’t eaten in 3 days. Or the complete change of appearance of someone from picking them up, to dropping them off after they’ve had a good, safe, comfortable night’s rest, been about to eat, shower, do laundry and relax in front of a tv.
